author: Mangolor
quote: A remake done right. They improved everything from a well beloved classic while retaining everything that made it great. The game looks gorgeous, it runs smoothly, lots of quality of life improvements.

author: Mangolor
quote: The game was clearly rushed out to meet GOTY deadlines. They didnt work out all the framerate drops and glitches which is ridiculous with the massive budget and time they had. There is absolutely zero excuses for a game this expensive to play so poorly.

author: Mangolor
quote:
MUST PLAY
It is a graphical feast for the eyes, definitely a next gen experience. The gameplay is very satisfying, from his movement to the feedback when destroying your environment. The game has alot of charm, with very expressive characters, emotive music and overall love letter to donkey kong. Absolutely perfect game!
